authors: W. Dong; J. A. Farrell; M. M. Polycarpou; V. Djapic; M. Sharma
title: Command Filtered Adaptive Backstepping
venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology 20(3):566-580
original_theorem_or_result: The paper's lemmas/theorems establish bounded signals during finite initialization and operating-phase properties identical to conventional adaptive backstepping under generalized parameter strict-feedback assumptions.
comparison_to_corrected_DSSM14_G12_R32: Adaptive updates plus compensated filter errors predate this candidate. A numeric gain gamma=12 or a gamma/kappa sweep is a tuning choice, not by itself a new theory result.

title: Adaptive command filtered backstepping tracking controller design for quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part G: Journal of Aerospace Engineering 226(5):483-497
original_theorem_or_result: Online updates address mass, inertia, actuator gain, and thruster misalignment; command filters enforce constraints; a modified Lyapunov tracking error handles saturation.
comparison_to_corrected_DSSM14_G12_R32: Direct quadrotor precedent for adaptive command-filtered control with saturation; plant and learned FEATURE Head differ.

authors: P. A. Ioannou; P. V. Kokotovic
title: Instability Analysis and Improvement of Robustness of Adaptive Control
original_theorem_or_result: Analyzes adaptive instability mechanisms with unmodeled high-frequency dynamics and bounded disturbances; derives sufficient robustness conditions and residual convergence for a modified scheme.
comparison_to_corrected_DSSM14_G12_R32: Relevant background for leakage/robust modifications; not a proof for this project's discrete G12 implementation.

authors: Z. Cai; M. S. de Queiroz; D. M. Dawson
title: A Sufficiently Smooth Projection Operator
original_theorem_or_result: Introduces a smooth parameter projection operator suitable when adaptive laws must be repeatedly differentiated.
comparison_to_corrected_DSSM14_G12_R32: DL1018 uses hard coordinate clipping after an Euler step, not this smooth projection; parameter clipping alone is not a closed-loop stability proof.
